No.55/4/CF-66(1)(i)
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
CABINET SECRETARIAT
(Department of Cabinet Affairs)

#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text:
The undersigned is directed to state that the following
Minister and Deputy Minister were appointed with effect from
the forenoon of January 11, 1966:-

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text:
Shri Asoke Kumar Sen --- Minister of Law and Social
Security.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text:
Shri S.V. Ramaswamy --- Deputy Minister in the
Ministry of Commerce.

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text: All Members of the Council of Ministers.

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text:
Copy forwarded to the Secretary to the Prime Minister/
the Private Secretary to the Prime Minister, for information.

#/texts/13.label: paragraph
#/texts/13.full_gt_text:
Copy forwarded to the Secretary to the President/the
Private Secretary to the Vice-President, for information.

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text:
(D.P. Chopra)
Under Secretary to the Cabinet.

#/texts/15.label: paragraph
#/texts/15.full_gt_text:
Copy forwarded to all Secretaries/Special Secretaries/
Additional Secretaries to the Government of India/Chairman,
Railway Board/Secretary, Election Commission, for information.

#/texts/16.label: paragraph
#/texts/16.full_gt_text:
Copy forwarded to all Ministries of the Government of
India/Lok Sabha Secretariat/Rajya Sabha Secretariat, for
information.

#/texts/17.label: paragraph
#/texts/17.full_gt_text:
(D.P. Chopra)
Under Secretary to the Cabinet.
